_about: Background life on the maps. Adventurers stand in for Fairyland's other players: a random race and look, sometimes with a companion, wandering and chatting. Villagers potter around towns. How many of each a map gets is its `crowd` in maps.json. Tap anyone to hear a line.
adventurerLines: The jellies here are so bouncy
Has anyone found the fairy ring?
Almost caught one... it ran away T_T
Heading to the shore, who's coming?
Remember to rest at the healer~
villagerLines: Mind the jellies past the gate.
Fresh bread at the market today!
The fountain sparkles at night, you know.
Have you visited the guilds yet?
Back in my day, bunnies were bigger.
Nurse Mira fixes up anyone for free.
Something glows in the Twilight Woods...
